title: A Name Is a Disclosure Too
description: Secret scanners match values, so a 1Password vault and item path or a real home directory in a public repo passes gitleaks and the content scanner and still tells a reader where to aim. This change scrubs one real op:// reference from six files and the operator home path from fifteen, moves the announce script's rotation target to a repository variable, and adds a static security test that fails on any reintroduced real name. The page lets you try a line against the same rules the test runs.
